Mo & Krill.why: Still the default sustained front line — Scorn/Burrow, Torment Pulse's +4% melee resist and an unchanged Combo keep him a lockdown tank — and 11-04 gives back some of what 10-30 took: Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50, plus weaker stacked anti-heal. Spirit per boon 0.6 still means he holds targets without threatening them.
Mo & Krill.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (direct): Scorn heal from heroes 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow damage radius +0.5m, Combo HP per kill 40->50; Sand Blast T2 slow/dash retuned to -28% (from -24%/-26%), tagged a nerf but a wash. Healbane stack ceiling 82.2%->72% indirectly helps Scorn sustain.
Halloween 2026: spirit per boon 1.1->0.6 and -10% spirit damage on every ability; Combo untouched, bullet per boon +4% — move one slot to gun (Bullet Lifesteal/Battle Vest). Torment Pulse +4% melee resist up; Decay's deeper self-heal penalty and Healbane heal-on-kill 275->170 down.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder Haunt camps and contested Buff Containers reward his sustained frontline; objective parries no longer reset, trimming the free Guardian-dive chain.

Kelvin.why: Support/healer whose dome is an objective-fight tool at Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza and whose Extra Regen/Healing Booster core the Radiant Regeneration trims never touched. 11-04 caps stacked anti-heal (4-stack 82.2%->72%), so a team's second and third Healbane can't fully blank Frozen Shelter; mobile dive and silence still end him.
Kelvin.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane stack ceiling 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay means multi-source anti-heal can't fully shut off Frozen Shelter/Healing Booster; Drifter's anti-heal bruiser variant is also hit.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps and Barrel Mimic fights raise dome/sustain value while cheap Healing Snacks cap the between-fight healing he used to sell; his dome is worth most at the announced hub contests, not in lane.
10-14: Radiant Regeneration spirit scaling 0.04->0.035 trims rival sustain (Baba, Lady Geist, Shiv, Celeste) while his Extra Regen/Healing Booster core is untouched - small relative gain.

Ivy.why: Still the best peel in the game (Stone Form i-frame/stun) and a 53.7% WR support; the 10-30 anti-heal stack that crushed tethers is capped (4-stack 82.2%->72%), so her heal path isn't dead — but Healing Booster/Healing Nova nerfs remain and Mo & Krill's buffs make displacement harder to heal through, so the gun core is still the build to fund.
Ivy.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane stack ceiling 82.2%->72% and 2-stack 57.8%->54.7% partially reverse the 10-30 tether-heal crush; one Healbane on the team is now the right amount. Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs make his displacement harder to heal through.
Halloween 2026 (indirect, item-driven): Healbane now stacks across sources — the worst system change for tether healing — Healing Booster lost its Extra Regen upgrade and +3 flat regen, and Healing Nova moved to spirit scaling off her gun-first build. Skip the heal package.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Healing Snacks plus spread corridors cut the value of a grouped healer; districts pull her team apart, so tether a frontline bruiser sweeping corridors instead of a lane partner.

Shiv.why: The knife exchange still wins (Serrated Knives rage 3.5%->4% current HP, +T3 spirit scaling) and 11-04's weaker stacked anti-heal buys back some buffer for Radiant Regeneration/Spirit Lifesteal, but Radiant Regeneration is still in-combat-only at 65->40 and Healbane's kill-heal was cut — he starts fights smaller than pre-10-30.
Shiv.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane stack ceiling 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay means the Radiant Regeneration + Spirit Lifesteal shell is less punishable by a team's second/third anti-heal source; his own single Healbane is unchanged.
Halloween 2026: Serrated Knives rage 3.5%->4% + T3 spirit scaling up, Killing Blow recast 16->12s, alt-fire per boon -5%; Radiant Regeneration went in-combat-only at 65->40 and Healbane kill-heal 275->170, so his pre-fight buffer is gone — Torment Pulse +4% melee resist is the offset.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps reward his regen stack and the rising frontline feeds current-HP Serrated Knives, but vents hand divers a free approach before he ramps.

Lady Geist.why: Regen frontline whose engine lost its out-of-combat half (Radiant Regeneration in-combat-only at 65->40, boon 1.7->1.4, spirit 0.35->0.25, bought in 98% of games), but 11-04's weaker stacked anti-heal makes Mystic/Radiant Regeneration harder to fully suppress and hits Drifter's anti-heal bruiser variant. Essence Bomb 1.22->1.35 still only pays the Soul-Exchange line.
Lady Geist.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane stack ceiling 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay makes her Extra Regen/Mystic Regeneration/Radiant Regeneration core harder to fully suppress; she buys no Healbane, so the trim is pure upside, and Drifter's anti-heal bruiser variant is hit.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Essence Bomb 1.22->1.35 spirit scaling only pays the Soul-Exchange line; Radiant Regeneration becomes in-combat-only at 65->40/1.7->1.4/0.35->0.25 on a 98%-buy slot, and Decay's incoming-heal penalty deepens -50->-55% on a core slot she fights out of.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps plus Barrel Mimic fights make farm a sustain check her regen stack passes, and container Bullet/Spirit Resist rolls add free frontline stats; the same dive heroes still eat her.

Dynamo.why: Tempo initiator whose Singularity wins the now pre-announced hub fights — fights are scheduled at Bell Tower and Sunken Plaza, so setup is planned rather than opportunistic. 11-04 makes one of his worst walls taller: Mo & Krill's Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50 let the tank survive Singularity longer.
Dynamo.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Mo & Krill — his worst listed loss — got Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50, so the durable frontline that eats Singularity is better at exactly that. No item driver; his Extra Charge/Arcane Surge/Refresher spine is untouched.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): hub contests are pre-announced (the Bell Tower rings map-wide), so his setup windows are planned rather than opportunistic — good for coordination, bad for surprise, raising the value of Unstoppable/Refresher on the channel.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): telegraphed Plaza/Bell Tower hub fights hand Singularity clean windows and Quantum Entanglement's AoE dispel beats rising Lash/Drifter/Calico commits; durable-frontline counters (M&K, Abrams) are the offset.

Holliday.why: Mobile lasso assassin built for the widened map: Steam Vent invisibility plus Barrel Mimic pauses create more stationary targets, and the map-wide Bell Tower call is a scheduled, pre-plannable pick window. 11-04 makes her worst matchup worse — Mo & Krill's Sand Blast T2 slow/dash cut to -28%, bigger Burrow radius and +10 Combo HP per kill punish her commit-heavy entry harder.
Holliday.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Mo & Krill — her listed hard loss — got Sand Blast T2 to -28% slow/-28% dash distance (from -24%/-26%), Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50, so the point-blank lockdown that punishes her entry got stronger. She buys no Healbane, so the item change does nothing for her.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): behavior-varied camps and Barrel Mimics leave farmers stationary at predictable spots — more lasso targets — and the Bell Tower payout is a scheduled map-wide announcement she can pre-place bounce pads around.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): new districts and Steam-Vent invisibility expand her roam routes and Bell Tower hub fights reward Spirit Lasso picks; point-blank lockdown still punishes her commit.

Seven.why: Jungle-payout carry: Haunt bounty and growth +10% lands squarely on the fastest one-cycle clearer in the game, and the new comeback levers (30% non-hero cap, tick souls to the two poorest) finally give a behind Seven a way back. The +10% Haunt HP/damage barely costs a one-pass clear, and Static Charge T3 stun 0.9->1.1s adds lockdown — but 11-04 makes Healbane a worse second/third slot, so his anti-heal counter-build is less of a hard counter. He still dies to dives and Hook CC-locks before his AoE is up.
Seven.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane stack ceiling 82.2%->72% and 2-stack 57.8%->54.7% make his anti-heal counter-build less of a hard counter when a teammate already runs one; one Healbane remains core. Ivy — a listed Seven loss — rebounds from the same cap.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Static Charge T3 stun 0.9->1.1s; Spirit Lifesteal +2/+2% and Healbane's multi-source anti-heal stacking are both core, and Haunt bounty/growth +10% is pure profit for the fastest one-cycle clearer — the new comeback levers also drop the 'farm a lead only' cap on a behind Seven.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): nine behavior-varied Haunt types (grouped/chasing) make the fastest camp clear the biggest income lever in the game; he has no crate or Barrel Mimic route and does not need one.

Ivy: trend falling -> stable; why/notes updated — anti-heal stack cap partially reverses tether-heal crush, but M&K buffs offset; tier A held.
Shiv: why/notes updated — anti-heal cap buys buffer for regen shell; still D/falling, no tier change.
Lady Geist: why/notes updated — anti-heal cap is pure upside for her regen core; tier A/falling held.
Dynamo: why/notes updated — Mo & Krill buffs make the durable frontline that eats Singularity stronger; tier A/rising held.
Holliday: why/notes updated — Mo & Krill's stronger lockdown worsens her worst matchup; tier D/rising held.
Seven: why/notes updated — Healbane second-source nerf weakens his anti-heal counter-build; farm spine unchanged, tier S/rising held.
